name: Local SEO Lesson - Module 8 Building Citations
body:
> Lesson · 2026-10-08

# Summary
Step-by-step citation building and clean-up.

# Key points
- A citation is any online listing of NAP, with or without a link; Google cross-references them to trust the business.
- Must-have sources: GBP, Bing Places, Yelp, Facebook, Apple Maps, Yellow Pages, Foursquare, Angi for home services, plus data aggregators (Localeze, Factual) and country or industry directories.
- Consistency: create a master NAP document and copy from it (watch "Street" vs "St.", "Suite" vs "Ste", tracking vs main numbers).
- Process per site: search for an existing listing first, claim or add, fill every field, verify, track status in a spreadsheet.
- Tools: LocalRank.so, Yext, Moz Local, BrightLocal; manual top 10 to 20 is fine to start.
- Avoid and merge duplicates; update or suppress old addresses and names.

# How this applies to TAG clients
- Tracking numbers on citations are a deliberate choice for some clients; decide per client with Scott before standardizing.
- Paid citation services need Kim's approval first (TAG rule: no paid services without an OK).
